scope: Future Qwen training on historical 6E signals for EURUSD research. Not a trade policy, independent evaluation or broker execution model.

inputs.type: Current completed receive-time snapshot: book depth, queue imbalance, OFI, CVD, passive executions, absorption and replenishment proxies

targets.unavailable_or_uncertain: Retained separately without a supervised completion; never relabeled neither_positive
targets.semantics: Observed quote outcome classes, not causal explanations, confirmed icebergs or an instruction to buy/sell

limitations: All three 2025 roles are already exposed development. The later roles must never be called untouched validation/test data.
Class imbalance and different opportunity rates across dates make headline accuracy misleading; compare against a no-opportunity/prior baseline and measure directional precision and coverage.

Excluding missing, late or inactivity-exposed outcomes conditions supervision on future observability; it is not evidence those cases would lose or that abstention can be inferred from their future status.
This step uses sampled snapshot cases, not the full raw order-event stream or temporal LOB sequences. It does not explain why a movement happened.
Futures quote proxies do not establish EURUSD CFD profitability, cross-market basis, broker spreads, commission or measured fills.
Active token lengths fit the contract, but the existing mask protocol pads to 2304 tokens. GPU memory headroom remains a separate tight hardware constraint.
next: Reserve genuinely disjoint, previously unopened evaluation sessions under a new versioned research scope without consuming their outcomes for training or tuning.
Implement a bounded task-specific Qwen LoRA training experiment using train.jsonl only; the old BTC advisory worker is not automatically compatible or approved for this task.
Compare frozen forecasts with fixed prior/no-opportunity controls. Any later trading deployment remains gated by independent cost-aware and broker-specific validation.
